label: Whatever is in act in a respect in which it could lack its act is MOTION_3 held there by another
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (respect-general concurrent actualization by another): whatever is in act in a respect r and could lack its act in r (Lackability.CanLack, definition 56b438a0-7fcc-4dd5-916b-1d2e2162310b) is MOTION_3 moved in r: something other than it presently actualizes it in r (HeldMotion, definition ea1904bc-bdfa-4835-a4a7-8545c5221e2e). It generalizes the strong concurrent actualization 76d2cc96-14a0-48bc-bd0b-a5c0ca853265 (received esse is given being by another whenever present) from esse to every respect, and is derived from its untimed esse instance with accident-inclusive conservation and the lackable-being premise. Existential inertia (Schmid 2021, Control part 1 of the concurrent-actualization batch) contests the esse instance; for a retained quality or a state of motion (a hot iron off the fire, a projectile) no physical present holder is known, so the premise requires a non-physical holder there. Its warrant is assessed on branch agent/sustaining-vs-inertia and is not judged here. The distinctness of the holder excludes a thing's own persistence power as its holder.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Instantiate respect-general concurrent actualization at esse, then apply the selected-world contingency-to-lackability and holder-to-actual-ground calibrations of the esse-only sibling.
connection_plan.blocker: The wider respect law produces holding at esse but includes neither the modal lackability calibration nor the selected grounding edge for that holder.
